walkthroughs.body_html: Linear design works for tightly defined briefs with low risk. Iterative design suits unknowns and lets ideas evolve. Many real projects mix both: linear for the plan, iterative for the product.
Velcro copies burr hooks; the Shinkansen bullet train's nose copies a kingfisher's beak. Biomimicry often produces efficient, sustainable solutions because nature has already optimised them.

A water bottle specification said: holds 750 ml, weighs under 200 g, leakproof. Testing shows 740 ml, 180 g, no leaks. Evaluation: meets two criteria fully and is within 1.5% on capacity — overall a success with one refinement needed.
